S024:0096.en: 「You just need to fight and that's all」

S024:0048.en:
「But they are Gadisword.Who knows if they will not

S024:0051.en:
「Roger.Everybody,we will identify the Gadisword
　Mechs as an ally」

S024:0123.en:
「As I've said before,we would like to prevent a

S082:0346.en:
「It seems that Hagane will be refueled and repaired at 
　the Abiano base.Hiryu Kai will head there too」

S103:0048.en:

　thought it would look like the hangar,but it was

S103:0079.en:
「I see...When we were taken out from Granteed,I

S103:0110.en:
「I see...When we were taken out from Granteed,I
　thought it would look like the hangar,but it was
　bigger than Izu base,let alone Hagane or Hiryu Kai」

S103:0151.en:
「I'd like to gather all the non-regular Steel Dragon
　Squad members to Kurogane,and carry out the search
　for the Fury's base」

S103:0208.en:
「...I know.I apologize,I'll need the Kurogane team's
　help」

S103:0218.en:

　With that,I'd like to make a request to the two of

S103:0162.en:

S030:0042.en:

　to the preparation of Buster Cannon.Do not let

S030:0044.en:

S030:0045.en:

　Hagane!」

S083:0309.en:

S083:0450.en:
「Raj's idea was right on the money...! With this,
　Excellence Gunstriker!」

S083:0520.en:
「No,I didn't.The design layout that is in Raj-san's
　and my head can't be deleted no matter what...」

S083:0254.en:

　their base,advanced over the sea,and have joined
　Kurogane」

S083:0286.en:

　That's why we excluded some mechs,like Ariad,which

S083:0308.en:

S083:0488.en:

S083:0277.en:

S083:0336.en:

S084:0181.en:

　Fairey's extradition when he attacked the Hagane

S084:0017.en:

S084:0020.en:

　Won't you be a dear and help me check it out?」

S084:0107.en:

S084:0054.en:

S084:0064.en:

　Since we are talking about Gadisword,so what's the

S084:0067.en:

　They're Zovork and Gadiswordian units!」

S084:0070.en:

S084:0080.en:

　conflict! It may even destroy the Gadiswordians
　in <Rubble Pile>」

S084:0083.en: 「I don't think they care about Gadisword's future!」

S084:0090.en:

　Gadisword!」

S084:0092.en:

S084:0101.en:

S033:0128.en:

S086:0085.en:

S086:0006.en:
「Well,the location of Gadisword's star system is still

　Hagane」

S035:0124.en:

S042:0101.en:

　disseminate disasters from the Cross Gate on

　With our Soulsaber,we will become the blade that will
　open up the future of Earth and Gadisword!」

S042:0269.en:

　Produce Gadisword's notice of surrender」

S042:0277.en:
「What a disgrace of Gadiswordians!
　I will personally execute you!」

「She wish to head to Rubble Pile with the company of 
　Sieg Altolied and Sally Emil to prompt a surrender
　from the remaining personnels of Gadisword」

S042:0328.en:
「I have to explore the solutions for the future of

　though」

Archive_OG1:0087.en:
To overcome a stalemate, Izu Base Commander Laker Randolf orders
Lieutenant Colonel Daitetsu Minase's Hagane to launch a direct
assault on the DC's main base. The Hagane is preparing to sortie,
when a DC team lead by Rai's older brother, Elzam, raids Izu Base...

Archive_OG1:0098.en:
Driven by desperate situation due to incoming barrage of large missiles,
Ryusei sucessfully startup Project SRX's R-1 Mech. The Hagane makes it
out of the woods and head towards Aidoneus Island. The SRX Team is saved
at the south pole from a tight situation with appearance of Masaki Ando,
pilot of Cybaster. To uncover Shu's whereabouts, he agreed to work with
Hagane.

Archive_OG1:0109.en:
They are joined by Johnson who has escaped from Langley Base. When they
receive the powerful Grungust, they hear that former S.T.F. squad member
Sanger Zonvolt has revolted against DC. Ryoto Hikawa is among the enemies
who launched the pre-emptive attack on Hagane. Having discovered that DC
made used of him as their POW, he decided to join Hagane's fight against
them.

Archive_OG1:0121.en:
The Hagane's offensive against the DC stronghold
on Aidoneus Island begins.
However, their Tronium Buster Cannon fails to penetrate
fortress's epic center. Captain Daitetsu decides to send
a PT squad to infiltrate the fortress.

Archive_OG1:0144.en:
After the battle at Aidoneus Island, the Hagane's crew responds to
a distress signal and hurry to the Principality of Riksent, a Federation
Special Administrative Region facing the Mediterranean Sea.
There, they rescue Princess Shine and drive out the DC remnants.

Archive_OG1:0155.en:
With Princess Shine in tow, the Hagane returns to Izu Base.
Upon their return, Ryusei and the rest of the SRX Team compete in
a test battle against Kyosuke Nanbu's ATX Team, which is part of
the assault humanoid mobile weapon development program, Project ATX.

Archive_OG1:0178.en:
Hagane and Hiryu Kai are dispatched to the scene. Bian's daughter,
Lune, shows up near Sector L5. Lune chooses to join Masaki and company
to fight the aliens. Rai's cousin, Leona, defects from the DC remnants
and pledges to cooperate with the Federation Forces. Around the same
time, Aerogator's leader Levi Tolah demands for Terra Federation
Government's surrender.

Archive_OG1:0189.en:
Princess Shine was kidnapped from Izu base during Commander Laker's
absence. In the midst of the confusion caused by Aerogator's appearance,
Adler Koch seizes the opportunity to attack Geneva with his DC remnant
troops. Former S.T.F. member Tempest Hawker appears and hindered Hagane
but he suffers a mental breakdown due to Valsion Kai's GEIM System's
side effects.

Archive_OG1:0200.en:
The Hagane and Hiryu Kai rush toward Geneva, but Tenzan and
mind-controlled Princess Shine appear with the Valsion Kai.
They narrowly defeat Tenzan and rescue Shine.
The DC War draws to an end, and with the help of Sanger who
had gone missing for a time, Adler's ambitions turn to dust.

Archive_OG1:0212.en:
Testing of the R-Series Mechs outfitted with Plus Parts is to be
carried out in China. On the way to the training grounds, a large
fleet of Aerogator appear before the Hagane. Ingram instructs
Ryusei and the others to deploy in SRX formation...

Archive_OG1:0223.en:
The crew of the Hagane are in shock when they discover that
Ingram, who fought beside them for so long, is an Aerogator spy.
Ryusei and the SRX Team vow to avenge Ingram's betrayal
with their own hands.

Archive_OG1:0268.en:
The Kurogane rushes to provide backup, and proceeds to the interior of
White Star after saving the skin of the Hagane crew. In the heart of the
White Star, Ingram awaits them with a final test. His mission is to advance
the Aerogators' assimilation of Terran military power by identifying human
candidates with special powers such information manipulation.

Archive_OG2:0073.en:
Hagane sets course for Shandong in pursuit of the DC remnants. The DC
remnants attack the LTR Organization's Dr. Anzai who is excavating the
ruins of Shiyu Mound for remains of ｢Chokijin｣ - the semi-living
biological weapons constructed in ancient times as guardians to fight
the ｢Hundred Evils｣. During the skirmish, an unknown entity warps
to the site.

Archive_OG2:0085.en:
The DC remnants launch their campaign to use Earth Cradle as their base.
The Hagane starts to track down the DC remnants. Latooni encounters
Arado Balanga, who she knows from her days in The School, as an enemy
captive. Arado has become a prisoner of war after taking a hit meant for
Seolla.

Archive_OG2:0096.en:
The DC remnants get wind of the Federation Forces' impending attack
on Earth Cradle, ｢Operation Molehunt｣, and so they launch a pre-emptive
assault on the Hagane. Yet another unknown entity appears during
the battle with the DC remnants. Kyosuke hears the voice of a girl
who calls herself an ｢Einst｣.

Archive_OG2:0177.en:
Noie DC occupies the Principality of Riksent as a base for its campaign
in Southern Europe. To liberate Riksent, Shirogwane and other teams staged
a diversion, allowing Hagane to launch an assault on the garrisoned Noie
DC forces. Latooni and Shine supported with the new Fairlion AM, freeing
the Principality. However, an error of judgment on the part of Shirogwane's
Captain Lee Linjun causes the ship to fall into enemy hands.

Archive_OG2:0258.en:
Tesla Leicht Institute is liberated from the Inspectors with Ibis
reunited with Filho and the rest. Operation Plantagenet draws to an end.
Hagane and Hiryu Kai raid Langley Base with the help of Van Vat Tran's
Noie DC. However Shadow Mirror are in league with the Inspector and
their joint surprise attack leaves Hagane in a bad shape...

Archive_OG2:0269.en:
The Einst appear. Taking advantage of the confusion, the Hagane
somehow manages to slip away; but Kyosuke is seriously wounded,
and its captain Daitetsu succumbs to his injuries.

Archive_OG2:0166.en:
Ibis and some others managed to escape from the Tesla Leicht Institute
in Project TD prototype Mechs. Sleigh's pride is wounded when she found
out she was not selected as α Proto's pilot, and she leaves the team.
Meantime, Dr Aguila Setome tampered with Seolla's memory. Seolla appears
before Arado, convinced by her false memories that he is an enemy.

Archive_OG2:0212.en:
Graien Grassman supporters favor an all-out resistance against the aliens.
At the Federation Izu Base, the Grassman faction staged a coup d'etat
codenamed ｢Mission Harper｣ which saw Commander Laker detained. The
｢Shadow Mirror｣ special task force headed by Vindel Mauser took advantage
of the confusion and shows up on scene. Lamia's hidden mission and true
identity are revealed...

Archive_OG2:0305.en:
The Einst commence their indiscriminate assault on various world powers'
military bases. An operation to capture Earth Cradle is launched amidst
the turmoil. Sanger faces off against Wodan, protector of the Magus
Gate. Ratsel and Rai defeat their sworn enemy Archibald as Kurogane
enters Earth Cradle. Meanwhile, Ouka recovers her memories with
Latooni's earnest persuasion.

Archive_OG2:0339.en:
The Hiryu Kai and Kurogane join forces for an attack on White Star.
Excellen shows up again on their way there. Despite the danger, Kyosuke
risks his life helping Excellen regains her sanity.

Archive_OG2:0351.en:
The Kurogane and Hiryu Kai launch a decisive surprise attack
on White Star. Kyosuke attacks Axel, but Echidna voluntarily
takes the hit and dies in Axel's place.

Archive_OG2:0363.en:
The Kurogane and Hiryu Kai infiltrate White Star. After a furious
battle, Kyosuke defeats Axel. Thereafter, the Inspector's Commander
Wendoro appears. The Inspector's conquest of Earth is intended to
prevent Terrans' insatiable thirst for war from destabilizing
the galaxy.

Archive_OG2:0374.en:
Although Kyosuke manages to defeat Wendoro, the Kurogane and Hiryu Kai
are trapped within White Star by an energy field deployed by the Einst.
The Shadow Mirror attempt to capture Guiliam so that they can use his
warp capabilities. The team manages to defeat Vindel however...

Archive_OGg:0006.en:
Their main force is routed by the Terra Federation Forces' flagship
Hagane, Hiryu Kai and Kurogane.

Archive_OGg:0088.en:
The human captives are used as living cores by the ｢ODE System｣, which
acts as a master controlling core. To shut down the ODE system, Hagane
and Hiryu Kai attempt to raid ｢Hell's Gate｣, the base of its creator,
Dr Jurgen.They rescue Kusuha and the others who were forced onboard
the Baltors and ventured into the heart of Hell's Gate.

Archive_OGg:0110.en:
The Hagane and Hiryu Kai have no option but to withdraw from
the scene, as the time for the Federation fleet's nuclear attack
on Hell's Gate draws near.

Archive_OGg:0271.en:
｢Operation Overgate｣ commences, using the ｢Dagger｣ warp device seized
from the Shura in an assault on Swordian. The Hagane and Hiryu Kai
successfully warped inside Swordian. Folka evolves into the deified
Ialdabaoth during his battle with Phernand.

Archive_OGg:0282.en:
Within Swordian, Shura Generals and King Alkaid try to stop the advancing
Hagane and Hiryu Kai. Both sides gave their all to the battle that decides
their fates. The defeated Shura King entrusts Shura and its future to Folka.

Archive_OGg:0294.en:
After defeating the Shura, Hagane and Hiryu Kai press on to the ｢inner
sanctum of Swordian｣, where Dunamis confronts them,bend on destroying them.
At that moment, Dark Brain appears- Roar's nemesis and Dunami's creator.

Archive_OGg:0178.en:
Folka protects Shoko but in a confrontation with Phernand, the latter
manages to slip past Folka's defenses and kidnaps Shoko again. An
exhausted Folka takes refuge in the Kurogane.He becomes acquainted
with Shoko's older brother Kohta and her grandfather Kisaburo, and
becomes determined to rescue her.

Archive_2OG:0067.en:
Joined by Mio Sasuga - one of those summoned from Earth - and her Diablo,
Masaki and the other ride out to stave off the Syutedonias force Midway,
the Steel Dragon Squad's Hagane appears in search of Masaki and his comrades,
who team up with the Space Noa-class multi-purpose battleship. Hot on Hagane's
tail is Ruozorl, an Archbishop of the Volkruss religious order.

Archive_2OG:0123.en:
The Hagane makes sail for Coral Canyon to rendezvous with Tyitti
Norrback, pilot of the Water Lord of Elemental, Gaddes. However,
lying in wait is the Steel Dragon Squad's SRX Team  which has been
taken hostage by Syutedonias forces and is forced to fight against
the Hagane.

Archive_2OG:0134.en:
The Hagane teams up with Tyitti's party and makes their way to
the Syutedonias-occupied Langran capital, to rescue the trapped
Princess Monica Grania Bilseia, second in line to the throne.
Before they arrive, an unknown Mech draws near...

Archive_2OG:0148.en:
At Prince Feil's request, the Hagane's crew launches an attack
on the Syutedonias force stationed in the city of Banan. An embattled
General Rodney Gesha brings out the Earth Lord of Elemental Zamzeed
as his trump card.

Archive_2OG:0171.en:
After recovering the Zamzeed from Syutedonias force, Masaki and company
realize that it has chosen Mio as its pilot. Hagane sides with Prince
Feil and make a feint to divert the Syutedonias force while Feil and his
troops attempt to recapture the Langran capital. They rescue Princess
Senia, who informs them that her younger sister Monica has been taken
away by Shu.

Archive_2OG:0227.en:
Feil's and Kirkus' allied forces defeat Syutedonias force and driven them
out of Langran. However, because the coronation ceremony was carried out
in Feil's absence, Prince Feil is convinced that an impostor was crowned
in place of Prince Terius. Hagane rushes to the scene having captured
a Masouki which is suspiciously like one of Kirku's troops.

Archive_2OG:0238.en:
Prince Feil's truce with General Kirkus ends because of the phony
coronation ceremony. Kirkus' troops march on the capital to capture
it, but the Hagane races over in time to stop them. After a decisive
battle, the defeated Kirkus vanishes.

Archive_2OG:0249.en:
On orders, the Hagane crew head for Grimold Mountain, where Syutedonias
force are hiding. Masaki and company enter the cave where they encounter
Volkruss high priest Ruozorl who is in league with Syutedonias force.
They discover that the temple for god of destruction, Sava Volkruss is
at this very location.

Archive_2OG:0260.en:
The Hagane crew defeat Volkruss' avatar and return to the capital.
However, the fragments of Volkruss cling to the Cybaster and the
avatar is revived. Prince Feil sorties in the newly-created Super
Masouki Durakseel, and exterminates the Volkruss avatar with its
overwhelming power.

Archive_2OG:0308.en:
The Steel Dragon Squad's Hiryu Kai and Hagane reunite
at RA-GEAS and return to the surface, leaving Masaki,
the Masouki pilots and Lune behind.

Archive_2OG:0517.en:
A dimensional rift spreads over the Earth, cutting it off from space.
The ES Wave released from the South Pole passes between the Hagane
and the Hiryu Kai, trapping the Hiryu Kai on Earth and flinging
the Hagane into space. The Hagane's crew realizes what is going on,
and race to Heaven's Gate, where the Ruina are headed.

Archive_2OG:0562.en:
On the way to Heaven's Gate,Hagane encounters the Guests who capitalize
the opportunity to seize control of the Earth and moon.Just as they succeed
in fighting off the enemy commander Glofis Raclayne,they run into the Beta
Sabers while providing aerial support for the battle in the South Pole.
There, the Einst Alfimi makes her appearance...

Archive_2OG:0573.en:
Having returned from an alternate world with former Shadow Mirror
captain Axel Almer, Alfimi leaves Axel at the Hagane before departing.
The Hagane changes course for the moon, when the Guests Commander
Justine Chaflowers suddenly shows up.
Axel's Vaisaga saves the Hagane from the perilous situation.

Archive_2OG:0584.en:
The Hagane teams up with Radha, who escaped from the Personal Trooper
manufacturer, Mao Industries, in a bid to flee the Guests. They hear that
Moon Cradle has been captured. The Omega Sabers' Amara Burton appears
in the Code 「Evil」 Galilnagant, relentlessly targeting Ing.
Alteur's plotting does not go unnoticed.

Archive_2OG:0595.en:
The Hagane team continues to Heaven's Gate, planning to capture
Ignis, who knows the truth about the barrier. However, the Guests,
who are eyeing Heaven's Gate for themselves, exchange hostilities
with the Ruina. The Hagane chases down Ignis as he retreats
from Heaven's Gate.

Archive_2OG:0606.en:
Meanwhile on Earth, Hiryu Kai continues toward the Arctic Ocean seeking
clues about the barrier. Bullet tries to reason with black Ko-o Ki that
appears before them to no avail. Upon reaching the magnetic South Pole,
Hagane encounters the Gaia Sabers who are about to assault the Septemplum
barrier. Hugo notices the Medius Locus which is supposed to stolen, senses
Mitarl's ulterior motives.

Archive_2OG:0631.en:
The Hagane chases Ignis and arrive in the Arctic sky instead of the South
Pole where Fabula Fores is. They engage in a fierce battle with Contagio
and the other Melior Esse they encounter, when another disaster befalls...

Archive_2OG:0642.en:
Due to the telepathic link between Rim and Ventos, the dimensional rift
that blankets Earth, the Artrum Exterior, disappears. The Hiryu Kai is
joined by the Hagane that has returned to Earth. Led by Ratsel, they
head to Iti'iti Island where there is a secret base.

Archive_2OG:0936.en:
Meanwhile, Hagane is still on Earth where it has been undergoing
repairs to its Tesla Drive. Alteur promises to stop pursuing the Steel
Dragon Squad but the Gamma Saber disregard the pact. Marshal Gaspard
sends the Hagane to the Gaia Sabers' main base Grand Christmas,
to settle the score regarding the Presidential assassination incident.

Archive_2OG:0947.en:
The Delta Sabers block the Hagane's route to Grand Christmas.
Minaki parts ways with her father, Dr Tomine. His grandiose dreams
are crushed by the power of Touma and the Rai-o.

Archive_2OG:0981.en:
At Grand Christmas, the Hagane crew are battling it out with Egretta
and the Gaia Sabers when the Garberus, the no. 10 TE Absorber prototype,
shows up, piloted by AI1. After a fierce fight, Erde falls.
Ing puts an end to Egretta, his prototype, with Black Hole Buster Cannon.

Archive_2OG:1029.en:
The Hiryu Kai and Hagane regroup. With the help of Glacies and Ventos,
they make it past the Meridemplum barrier. Aquila and Contagio lie in
wait at Mother Base, but are defeated by the Steel Dragons. They enter
the site of the ruins...

Archive_2OG:0743.en:
Medius Locus withdraws leaving Aqua behind. She is devastated that her
mistake caused the loss of Hugo and discovers that he did not have long
before his body would have been completely mechanized. The Steel Dragon
Squad heads to Iti'iti Island.Ibis is on patrol duty when Sleigh Presty
appears alone far from Isurugi Heavy Industries, searching for the Steel
Dragons. Ibis resolves to stop Sleigh once and for all...

Archive_2OG:0754.en:
Sleigh defeats the mercenary, Araseli, and joins the Steel Dragon Squad.
She conveys a shocking message regarding Shu Shirakawa from
Mitsuko Isurugi, President of Isurugi Heavy Industries.

Archive_2OG:0424.en:
The truths and secrets behind Project Idealants, the death of its
supervisor, Dr Ozunu, and the ｢Faul Kern｣ power source of the Alles Geist
are known by Ariel Org, who decides to break away from the Gaia Sabers.
Around this time, Tesla Research is attacked by the Yokijin, who are
targeting the Ryu-o Ki, which is undergoing repair.

Archive_2OG:0435.en:
Raul and company drive away the Yokijin and captured an approaching Mech
which turns out to be the Flickerei Geist with its pilot Arierre. Captain
of the Gaia Sabers and Beta Sabers, Duvan Org, appears in his Alles Geist,
hot on Ariel's tail. He demands that she be handed over to him together
with Ing who just happens to be at the wrong place at the wrong time.

Archive_2OG:0446.en:
Seemingly intent on awakening Ing, the mysterious Code ｢Evil｣ swiftly
vanishes. Ariel tells of what brings her here - her identity as an
artificial human ｢Idealant｣ created under Project Idealants, and her
mission to warn of the dangerous nature of the ｢Faul Kern｣
power source that makes up the Jetzt Regisseur's core.

Archive_2OG:0089.en:
At the same time, Lune Zoldark, who has been tracking Noie DC refugees'
movements, was summoned to RA-GEAS too, where she meets the Flame Lord of
Elemental Granveil, piloted by Huang Yang Long. General Kirkus Xan Valhalevia
and the Langran Kingdom troops are the vanguard of Langran's liberation.
Yang Long joins them as backup, targeting the invading Syutedonias force.

Archive_2OG:0100.en:
To rescue her Steel Dragon Squad comrades, Lune confronts Syutedonias
force. Langran's Lord of Elemental Mechs were developed under the general-
purpose humanoid weapon program, ｢Masouki Project｣ to counter the Majin
prophesied by Langran Royal Academy's seers. However these existences viewed
as dangerous by Syutedonias are part of reasons behind their invasion of
Langran.

Archive_2OG:0111.en:
Yang Long harbors doubts about General Kirkus. Word from his old acquaintance,
Crimson Safeene that the missing Prince Feillord Gran Bilseia, first in line
to throne of Langran Kingdom is alive. Lune's party reunites with Hiryu Kai,
the Steel Dragon Squad's all-purpose battleship. Captain Lefina meets General
Kirkus and promises to support him in order to return to the surface.

Archive_2OG:0193.en:
Hiryu Kai's crew hears from General Kirkus that Terrans are trapped in
Syutedonias force's base. Yang Long and Lune infiltrate the base.where
former S.T.F.squad member Sanger Zonvolt appears and together they rescue
the hostages. On their way to rendezvous with General Kirkus, Hiryu Kai
encounters Shu Shirakawa, fearful of him plotting Volkruss's resurrection.

Archive_2OG:0215.en:
Yang Long parts ways with General Kirkus, who is trying to seize power
by crowning Prince Terius and getting rid of the true heir, Prince Feil.
Kirkus's ambition to unite RA-GEAS by force reminds Lune Zoldark
of her late father Bian Zoldark.

Archive_2OG:0810.en:
On their way there, a patrolling Masaki notices Lune and some others
who have surfaced from RA-GEAS, in a skirmish with the Ruina. The Steel
Dragon Squad commences their assault on Tochka 8. Josh leads a team in
search for the NV Units.

Archive_2OG:1180.en:
The Gaia Sabers are dissolved following the revelation that Alteur was
behind the L5 Campaign and evidence of the Presidential assassination
plot found at Grand Christmas. The Zovork Privy Council adopts a policy
of non-intervention vis-a-vis Earth. The Guests leave Earth Orbit except
for Mekibos who remains on Earth as their liaison. Masaki and the other
Masouki pilots return to RA-GEAS with Lune.

Archive_2OG:0376.en:
On board the attacking Armored Modules were bioroids resembling those
used by the Inspectors, aliens who have attempted to invade Earth.
On their way back to Izu, the S.T.F. team attempts to rendezvous with
the Kurogane to receive the Exbein with adjustable AM parts,
developed in secret.

Archive_2OG:0387.en:
A message from the mysterious Zinlai enemy Mech establishes its identity
as a Dynamic General Guardian (DGG) with objectives to destroy the DGG
no.1 and DGG no.2. They were caught off-guard on their way back due to
the unexpected battle with the enemy AM team, Kurogane crew find themselves
in a bad situation when a group of mobile weapons warped to their location.

Archive_2OG:0899.en:
Aware of his 3-year Idealant lifespan, Duvan splits from the Gaia Sabers
and absorbs Alfimi in a bid to escape from his fate. Ibis and company
defeated the enemy but upon their return to the ship, they discover that
Irui has disappeared.

Archive_2OG:0159.en:
In response to Yang Long's questioning about why he is ignoring Prince
Feil, Kirkus wonders aloud whether Feil had anything to do with the
summoning incident. With the Barrier of Harmony in ruins and the looming
threat of resurrection of the god of destruction Volkruss, crew of the
Hiryu Kai race to the temple of Volkruss to investigate.They arrive in
time to rescue Leona from being sacrificed to Volkruss by high priest Ruozorl.

Archive_2OG:0182.en:
Meanwhile, Hiryu Kai escorts the convoy of Prince Terius Gran Bilseia,
third in line to the throne, who is under the protection of Kirkus'
troops. General Kirkus orchestrates the coronation of Prince Terius,
worrying Yang Long by creating a new volatile situation in Langran.

Archive_OGDP:0136.en:
Terius believes Shu's words and absconds from Kirkus' camp. Shu prepares
to train Terius till he acquires adequate power. In the meantime an
impostor is crowned in Terius' place as a puppet king for Kirkus who
intends to wield the true power behind the throne. Prince Feil notices
this and confronts Kirkus. Hagane drive Kirkus'army out from the royal
capital leaving him in a tight spot...

Archive_OGDP:0089.en:
The encounter of the Steel Dragon Squad and Masaki, pilot of the Lord
of Elemental Cybaster brings Shu's memory back. Shu intercepts Kirkus'
mercenaries Araseli and Sleigh with Albada and his team who arrive as
backup. Shu agrees to Monica's request to seize the Nols, the no.1
prototype of the Masouki Project which the Syutedonias force is after.

Archive_OGDP:0114.en:
Shu drops in on Prince Terius who is under Kirkus' custody to persuade
Terius to lend him his strength. Meanwhile, Albada and the other lure
Kirkus' troops' Masouki away from camp. As Terius is being conveyed to
General Kirkus, Shu follows and skirmishes with Kirkus' troops.
Kirkus' allies, the Steel Dragon Squad and Lune Zoldark, appear.

Archive_OGDP:0067.en:
On her way back to base after a secret rendezvous with old friend and
Lord of Elemental pilot Huang Yang Long, Safeene crosses paths with some
Syutedonias force. Serena rushes to back her up. Selena's autonomous
support robot partner, Elma, plans an attack on a battleship that looks
suspiciously like one of the Steel Dragon Squad's ships.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0021.en:
Heavy mobile weapon of the <Gaia Sabers>.Installed
　with the high output generator「Faul Kern」also used
　in the core of the large <Jetzt>,it is a power fighter
　adept at close quarters and shooting combat.Also,
　parts of the machine contains muscle,epithelial
　and nerve tissues.
　
　As a mimic of the <Einst>,the Jetzt used a semi-
　bio weapon completely controlled by human hands,
　similar to the Rein Weissritter of <The Steel 
　Dragon Squad>,and as an artificial prototype that
　exceeds the original,is also used to collect data.
　
　Piloted by Duvan Org <Idealant>,it fought multiple
　times with the Steel Dragon Squad,and ultimately
　lost.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0052.en:
Company set up by Raul and Fiona after the end of
　the <Shura no Ran>.「L」and「E」are the initials
　of「Lightning」and「Eternal」respectively,undertaking
　work that makes full use of the Excellence Rescue's
　capabilities.Raul is the President with Raj the Vice
　-President,with operations and management handled
　by Fiona.Mizuho takes care of the Excellence,with
　Despinis supporting whenever necessary.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0096.en:
An engine that was in development by the fathers of
　Raul and Fiona,and Raj.As long as time flows,it is
　able to extract time particles anywhere to turn the
　turbine（Time Turbine）to obtain power.
　
　However if it goes out of control,there is a chance of
　dimensional warp into a parallel world.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0007.en:
Late in <The DC War>,the use of the special properties
　of the <Terra Federation Forces> multi-purpose battleship
　Hagane was successful in the storming of the <DC> main
　base on <Aidoneus Island>.
 　
　Originally,the Tronium Buster Cannon on the bow was
　intended to destroy the nerve center of the DC,however,
　it was damaged by the DC flagship,the similar Space
　Noa-class battleship Kurogane.After that the Hagane
　deployed a mixed team of <PT> and <Super Robot> and
　fought hard against the DC's inferior <Armored Module>.
　
　Finally,the DC commander,<Bian Zoldark> deployed the
　Valsion with him onboard,but was attacked by the
　Hagane's PT and Super Robot team.The Valsion was
　shot down,and Bian Zoldark was killed.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0008.en:
A suspicious organization that appeared in Terra
　orbit from <New A.D.>187 to 188.
　
　With the mysterious bio weapon known as the
　Einst Series as their main force,it was initially
　repeating some baffling battle tactics in a limited
　area.The precise purpose and intelligence,and
　communication ability was held by a senior Einst
　known as Regisseur and a young girl called Alfimi.
　The organization's formations are similar to that of
　a bee and an ant.
　
　In addition,the Einst has existed since time immemorial
　in a different space（Einst space）,and seems to be
　monitoring the movements of intelligent life in the
　current world however details are not clear.Continuous
　fighting has disrupted the silence of the universe and
　leads to the annihilation of humankind.The objective
　was to create new intelligent life,but when the Einst
　space was finally connected to the current world they
　begin to carry out the encroachment.
　
　The Einst has fought the Hagane,Kurogane,Hiryu
　Kai countless times,and in the final battle,Neu
　Regisseur combined with the <White Star>.While
　it became the super large mobile weapon Sterun
　Neu Regisseur,it was defeated by the Kurogane
　and the Hiryu Kai.Furthermore after the destruction
　of the Sterun Neu Regisseur,other Einst Series active
　in other lands met the same fate.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0033.en:
A soldier of the <Terra Federation Forces>,and the
　central figure of the <Project SRX>.His real identity
　is actually a special agent of the <Aerogator>.His
　main mission was to collect information about Earth,
　as well as to uncover and develop people with
　Telekenisis powers.Furthermore,he is to subject
　humans' fine weaponry to further evolution by
　bringing about <EOT>,such as the <Tronium> Engine
　on purpose.
　
　Later in the <L5 Campaign>,he was defeated in
　repeated skirmishes with Hagane's and Hiryu Kai's
　mixed <PT> and <Super Robot> platoon,and died.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0058.en:
At the end of the <L5 Campaign>,this was the bold
　attack on the <White Star> by the <Terra Federation 
　Forces>.
　
　While the fleet and mobile weapons attack in waves
　from all sides,diverting the enemy mobile weapons,
　allowing the Hagane and Hiryu Kai to penetrate the
　White Star from the outside.Mobile troops from both
　ships entered and destroyed the central portion.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0059.en:
Name of the decisive infiltration operation into the
　giant structure Swordian（teleporting fortress）during
　the <Shura no Ran>.
　
　Using the teleportation device taken from <Shura>,
　the Hagane and Hiryu Kai was moved into the
　internal portions of the Swordian in a one-way
　operation.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0077.en:
The Far Eastern <Terra Federation Forces> First
　Independent Special Tactical Team,set up after the
　conclusion of the <Shura no Ran>.It is made up of
　the multi-purpose battleships that have generated
　multiple battle achievements,the Hagane and the
　Hiryu Kai,as well as high performance <Personal 
　Trooper> and <Armored Module> special humanoid
　mobile weapons onboard.It is great at ISA（lightning
　battles with a mobile battleship serving as a carrier,
　with many humanoid mobile weapons on board）tactics.
　
　After <The Sealing War> it came under the direct command
　of the Terra Federation Forces Joint Command Headquarters,
　and Brigadier General Miles Boothroyd became the new
　Squadron Commander.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0088.en:
An organization that came from a parallel world
　by the space dimension warp device「System XN」.
　
　Its former form was a Special Missions platoon of the
　<Terra Federation Forces> in the parallel world.After
　the <L5 Campaign>,they undertook secret moves to
　help the <DC> remnants in their military uprising.
　
　They contemplated maintaining a state of war using
　the mass-produced mobile weapon androids known
　as「W series」,which they regarded as more complete
　than the System XN,but they were defeated by the
　Hagane and the Hiryu Kai.
　
　It should be noted that Lamia Loveless was a member
　of the W-series(she was called W17).During <The 
　Inspector Incident>,she deserted Shadow Mirror after
　achieving self-consciousness.She is current a member
　of the <Special Tactical Fighter Training Group> under
　the Terra Federation Forces.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0093.en:
A war that resulted from the warp of the combat
　organization「<Shura>」from the alien「Shura Kai」
　to Earth Orbit.
　
　With the Shura-Kai facing the danger of extinction,
　the king of「Rakoku」one of its countries,Alkaid,
　led the Shura into an alternate dimension looking
　for a new world,by using the giant sword-shaped
　structure with the ability of dimension warp,
　「Teleporting Fortress」（Codenamed Swordian by Earth）.
　
　They arrived in Earth Orbit after <The Inspector Incident>,
　attacking multiple locations on Earth using their
　<Shura-Shin> mobile weapons.Several cities were
　occupied by the Shura,but were subjected to the
　decisive action by the Hagane and the Hiryu Kai
　forces that teleported and infiltrated the Fortress
　in「<Operation Overgate>」.
　
　Doubtful about the Shura way of life,Folka Albark
　became an ally of the Terra Forces,and was successful
　in defeating Alkaid.
　
　After the end of the war,Folka and the remaining
　Shura,moved to another dimension via the Teleporting
　Fortress,and left the Earth Orbit.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0106.en:
During <The Sealing War>,the multi-purpose
　battleship of <The Steel Dragon Squad>,Hagane,
　fell into the ruse of Alteur（「<Euzeth>」）,the
　commander of the <Gaia Sabers>.It attacked the
　transport ship carrying <Terra Federation Government>
　President,Graien Grassman,causing his death.Labeled
　as the culprit that assasinated the President,the Steel
　Dragon Squad was chased not only by the Gaia
　Sabers but also by the <Federation Forces>.
　
　However after The Sealing War,Alteur's plan was
　brought to light and cleared all suspicion on the
　Steel Dragon Squad.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0113.en:
Refers to <The Steel Dragon Squad>'s all purpose
　battleship Hagane.
　
　This is because to both sides of the bow,are beam
　focusing induction devices that are shaped like a
　ball（pearl）,causing the Hagane to have such a
　nickname.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0126.en:
A war ignited by the <DC> between the end of
　<New A.D.> 186 to 187.
　
　Revolting against the <Terra Federation Government>
　and the <Federation Forces>,it was successful with
　lightning quick attacks in suppressing army bases
　all over the world using the <Armored Module>.
　
　However,during a surpise attack by the Hagane on
　<Aidoneus Island>,the commander,<Bian Zoldark> died
　in battle.His loss led to confusion amongst the DC
　organization,and was defeated by the Federation Forces.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0129.en:
A military association serving as the parent body
　to the <EOTI> by <Dr Bian Zoldark>,who predicted
　the invasion by aliens.With the aim of resisting
　aliens who are scheming to invade Earth,he built a
　formidable military regime in Earth Orbit.
　
　Aside from EOTI members,Federation Government
　personnel,some <Federation Forces> soldiers,anti
　Terra Federation advocates and militants of the
　Ethnic Liberation Front also joined,with the <United 
　Colony Corps> showing its readiness to support.
　
　At the end of <New A.D.>186,they revolted against
　the <Terra Federation Government> and the <Federation 
　Forces> ,and was successful with lightning quick attacks
　in suppressing army bases all over the world using the
　<Armored Module>.
　
　However,the methods used by Bian and the United
　Colony Corps commander Meyer Von Blanstein,was
　a doube-edged sword.By becoming the「enemy」
　on their own accord,they were placed in a situation
　where they were recognized as a sham by Terrans,
　with the intention of instigating action against an
　unprecedented threat as soon as possible.But the
　continuation of civil war on Earth results in high
　danger of exhaustion for the forces.
　
　As a result,they wanted a quick end to <The DC 
　War>,having to take measures that also preserved
　the strength of the enemy（Federation Forces）to
　some extent.Also,if someone with the power to
　defeat Bian appears,they were thinking about
　entrusting the future Earth Orbit to them.
　
　This paradox thought up by Bian led to his defeat,
　and can be said to have allowed who are using
　<DC> for their own self interests to become
　arrogant.
　
　Furthermore,Bian died in battle during the surprise
　raid on the DC headquarters by the Hagane.His defeat
　put the DC into disarray,resulting in its defeat by
　the Federation Forces.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0146.en:
The incident where the cities and <Federation Forces>'
　bases were attacked due to the mass rampage of
　Baltor humanoid mobile weapons developed by Won
　Heavy Industries.
　
　The main culprit was Wilhelm von Jurgen.The Hagane
　and Hiryu Kai assaulted Jurgen's base,which is also
　the space plant that was mass producing the Baltor,
　bringing a close to the incident.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0001.en:
A giant artificial hibernation facility under construction
　for Project Ark（seed storage project）driven by the
　<EOT Council>.
　
　Built underground in Africa,Kenya District,it is managed
　by an autonomous supercomputer,Magus,developed by
　Dr.Sophia Nate.
　
　In order to survive the coming invasion from the <Aerogator>,
　several thousands were planned to undergo artificial
　hibernation,but the start of <The DC War> disrupted the
　construction.
　
　After being conquered by the remnants of the <DC> when
　the war ended,it became their base,however it was
　critically damaged in battle with the Kurogane team.It
　was then placed under the management of the <Federation 
　Forces> Special Research Institutes.
　
　Furthermore a similar facility,the「Moon Cradle」,exists
　on the moon.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0034.en:
Group sent from <Zovork> to Earth orbit.Seeing that
　Terrans' thirst for war will lead to chaos in the
　galaxy,came to the conclusion that the Earth must be
　placed under their control.
　
　Furthermore,the name Inspector,was used for convenience
　by their combat commander,Vigaji,during battle with the
　Hiryu Kai,but eventually became the codename for Earth.
　
　The attack began in <New A.D.>187,the lightning attack
　tactics resulted in <White Star>,the moon and main
　portions of North America being occupied.However,
　the <Terra Federation Forces> counterattack,「<Operation 
　Plantagenet>」,and being swept into the chaos that resulted
　from the outbreak of large numbers of <Einst> series,had
　no choice but to withdraw from Earth.
　
　After that,they lost in the final battle at White Star
　to the Kurogane and the Hiryu Kai,and main members
　including overall commander Wendoros,died in battle.
　The Inspector has been destroyed.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0035.en:
The name of the disturbance that resulted from
　the <Inspector>,that happen from <New A.D.>
　187 to 188.
　
　The Inspector,is an alien organization that comes
　from another star system to investigate the
　culture on Earth.Concluding that the people of
　Earth have an insatiable appetite for war,and
　that the order of the galaxy is disrupted,they
　envisioned a plan to place Earth Orbit under
　their control.
　
　At the start of the invasion in New A.D.187,
　the blitzkreig tactics used resulted in the
　occupation of the the Moon and main areas of
　the North America District etc.However,they
　were caught up in large outbreak of the <Einst>
　Series,and were forced to withdraw from Earth
　and were completely destroyed in the final
　battle,losing to the Kurogane and the Hiryu Kai.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0164.en:
An ultra large ball-like space fortress used by the
　<Aerogator> as headquarters during the <L5 Campaign>.
　Its official name is the「Autonomous Satellite Nevi'im」,
　but is known on Earth by the codename White Star.
　
　Inside,it has a mobile weapon plant,space docks,
　residential areas with quasi-weather functions at
　1G,multiple farms,and can be said to be a mobile
　space colony.There is a theory that the Aerogator
　plans to bring back with them in great numbers,
　Terrans that have high competitiveness and
　battle ability,however details are unclear.
　
　Towards the end of the L5 Campaign,it was critically
　damaged by the combined attack of the combined
　space forces under <Operation SRW>,and it stopped
　functioning.After the war,it was placed under the
　command of the <Terra Federation Forces>.
　
　However in <New A.D.>187,the Earth Orbit was
　suppresed and taken over by the <Inspector>,using
　military force,and it became their main headquarters.
　Furthermore,it fused with the head of the <Einst>,
　Einst Neu Regisseur,and transformed into the ultra
　large weapon Sterun Neu Regisseur.The Kurogane
　and Hiryu Kai teleported into the alternate space
　together,and after repeated fierce battles,led to its
　destruction in the end.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0016.en:
One of the powerful tribes on the Gadisword world.
　The Annex camp took control of the civil war
　happening on the same world.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0019.en:
Spaceship used by the Gadiswordian,Fairey Klivia,when she
　came to Earth.It is an aircraft with two main wings and
　four tail wings.Codenamed「Drift Wing」by the
　<Terra Federation Forces>.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0105.en:
Refers to the <Cross Gate>.In Gadiswordian language,it
　means the「Door of Hell」.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0186.en:
One of the clans on the Gadisword world.Low in
　numbers,but has produced excellent scholars.During
　the Gadisword civil war,it was aligned with the <Annex>
　clan.

KeyWordData_definition_1:0187.en:
Giant Gadisword space fortress designed by Helluga
　Izberga.Made of smaller planets,it is a military
　facility for many mobile weapons as well as a port
　for spaceships including docks,factories and living
　areas.
　
　It is also installed with large weaponry including the
　super large cannon and thus,can be used as a battle
　carrier.It also has a spatial warp device but it takes
　a lot of time to use it.
